# Stocks – weekly prices of six tech stocks 2018–2019 (wide format)

Weekly prices of GOOG, AAPL, AMZN, FB, NFLX and MSFT, normalised to 1.0 on the first date – one column per stock (wide format, good for practising `melt`). Exported from `px.data.stocks()`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Download | [`stocks.csv`](https://github.com/stefanko-ch/practice-datasets/releases/download/v1/stocks.csv) (13 KB) |
| Rows | 105 |
| Source | [https://plotly.com/python-api-reference/generated/plotly.express.data.html](https://plotly.com/python-api-reference/generated/plotly.express.data.html) |
| License | MIT (plotly.py sample data) |

## Columns

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `date` | Week |
| `GOOG … MSFT` | Price relative to the first week |
